🌊 DON'T SPLASH VERITY 🌊
Jump across giant pool rooms. Touch the water and the Verities come for you INSTANTLY.

👁️ 36 LEVELS, 6 WORLDS
WORLD 1: VERITY • FREEZITY • DARKITY • FALSITY • LOVITY • ROBOTITY
WORLD 2: OBESITY • FARTITY • ELECTRICITY • INFERNITY • PANICITY • CRUELTY
WORLD 3: PEEKITY • GRAVITY • SQUISH-ITY • SINGITY • DOORITY • INVISIBLITY
WORLD 4: EVILITY • PLANTITY • MEMORITY • HELPITY • ANGELITY • GLITCHITY
WORLD 5: SADITY • CARITY • ROCKITY • RICHITY • CLOWNITY • MECHITY
WORLD 6: MINIGUNITY • HEAVENITY & HELLITY • SPEEDITY • ANTIVERITY • SKETCHITY • TOWERITY

Beat a world to unlock the next one!
NEW VERITIES EVERY WEEK!

🏁 Race everyone live on the top bar
🏆 Fastest + most escapes leaderboards
🖐️ SLAP people off platforms
❄️ FREEZE CRYSTAL freezes the Verities
🍌 Drop BANANAS, make people slip
🐣 Collect baby Verity pets
🎁 Daily rewards: log in 7 days for an exclusive pet
🪢 Revive friends, escape once to unlock the RESCUE ROPE free

Can you escape every Verity? 😈
